tagline.en_US: Run a lightweight identity provider that uses passkeys for sign-in and can provide OpenID Connect to other applications. ProxMenux creates an encryption key and sets the application URL to this container address.

description.en_US: Pocket ID is an OpenID Connect and OAuth 2.0 provider designed for simplicity. It allows users to authenticate to self-hosted applications exclusively using passkeys instead of passwords. This enables secure, passwordless logins across multiple services with hardware keys or biometrics.
